newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek C/A deficit down 3.1pct y/y in April-cbank.
newsitem.headline: Greek C/A deficit down 3.1pct y/y in April-cbank.

text.p: Greece's current account deficit fell a provisonal 3.1 percent year-on-year to $660 million in April from $681 million in the same month a year ago, the central bank said on Thursday.
"The improvement is solely attributed to a significant $92.8 million or 5.8 percent reduction in the trade deficit while the invisibles surplus narrowed by $71.4 million or 7.9 percent," it said.
The cumulative current account deficit in the first four months of the year was up 21.3 percent to $2.287 billion compared to the same period in 1996, it added.
The trade deficit shrunk 5.8 percent year-on-year to $1.496 billion in April from $1.59 billion in the same month last year.
Forex reserves in June stood at $16.3 billion, unchanged from the previous month.
